hooks.command: f="$FILE_PATH"; [ -z "$f" ] && f="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.tsx|*.ts|*.css|*.html) if [ -x node_modules/.bin/prettier ]; then node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi;; esac; exit 0
hooks.description: Auto-format edited frontend files if prettier is installed (soft no-op otherwise)

hooks.command: if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"build"' package.json; then echo '[hook] running vite build…'; npm run build >/tmp/aegntic-stop-build.log 2>&1 || { echo '[hook] BUILD FAILED: see /tmp/aegntic-stop-build.log'; tail -30 /tmp/aegntic-stop-build.log; exit 2; }; echo '[hook] build green'; fi
hooks.description: Verify production build at session end (cwd-guarded to this project only)
